items.docs: Create a new WAP or KSD security configuration. KSD security configurations start out empty, and WAP configurations are created with preset values. The contract you pass in the request body determines which product you use.  You can edit the default settings included in the WAP configuration, but you'll need to run additional operations in this API to select specific protections for KSD. Your KSD configuration needs match targets and protection settings before you activate. _Products:_ All.

params.name: includeHostnames
params.description: If `true`, include the list of hostnames protected by this security configuration in the production network.  If `false`, exclude the list of hostnames protected by this security configuration in the production network.

params.name: configId
params.description: A unique identifier for each configuration.

params.name: page
params.description: The index of the result page. If the value is `-1`, then pagination is ignored.  The default value is `1`.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of items on each result page. The default value is `25`.

params.name: detail
params.description: When `true`, the results contain detailed information on versions. With the default `false`, the results contain summary information on versions.
